Flux2AIO.description: Flux2 All-In-One Node - Integrated node with main model, VAE, CLIP, 4 LoRAs, 5 image inputs, positive/negative prompts, KSampler and VAE decode. Supports text-to-image/image editing dual modes with image reference feature

generation_mode.name: Generation Mode
generation_mode.tooltip: Generation Mode - Select text-to-image or image editing mode

image_reference_strength.name: Image Reference Strength
image_reference_strength.tooltip: Image Reference Strength - Controls the influence of input images on the generation result (0.0-2.0)

auraflow_shift.name: AuraFlow Shift
auraflow_shift.tooltip: AuraFlow Shift - Sampling shift parameter for Flux2 model, affects speed and quality (0-100)

main_model.name: Main Model
main_model.tooltip: Main Model - Flux2 main model (UNET), the core diffusion model for image generation

vae_model.name: VAE Model
vae_model.tooltip: VAE Model - Variational Autoencoder for encoding/decoding latent space to visible images

clip_model.name: CLIP Model
clip_model.tooltip: CLIP Model - Text encoder that converts text prompts into conditions the model can understand

lora_01.name: LoRA 1
lora_01.tooltip: LoRA 1 - First LoRA model for style or feature fine-tuning

lora_01_strength.name: LoRA 1 Strength
lora_01_strength.tooltip: LoRA 1 Strength - Influence strength of LoRA 1 on the model (-10.0 to 10.0)

lora_02_strength.name: LoRA 2 Strength
lora_02_strength.tooltip: LoRA 2 Strength - Influence strength of LoRA 2 on the model (-10.0 to 10.0)

lora_03_strength.name: LoRA 3 Strength
lora_03_strength.tooltip: LoRA 3 Strength - Influence strength of LoRA 3 on the model (-10.0 to 10.0)

lora_04_strength.name: LoRA 4 Strength
lora_04_strength.tooltip: LoRA 4 Strength - Influence strength of LoRA 4 on the model (-10.0 to 10.0)

positive.name: Positive Prompt
positive.tooltip: Positive Prompt - Text prompt describing desired image content and features

negative.name: Negative Prompt
negative.tooltip: Negative Prompt - Text prompt describing image elements or features to avoid

width.name: Width
width.tooltip: Width - Generated image width (64-8192, multiple of 8)

height.name: Height
height.tooltip: Height - Generated image height (64-8192, multiple of 8)

batch_size.name: Batch Size
batch_size.tooltip: Batch Size - Number of images to generate at once

seed.name: Random Seed
seed.tooltip: Random Seed - Controls randomness, same seed produces same image

steps.name: Steps
steps.tooltip: Steps - Number of iterations in the denoising process, more steps usually means better quality but slower

cfg.name: CFG Scale
cfg.tooltip: CFG - Classifier-Free Guidance scale, controls prompt adherence (higher = more faithful but may reduce quality)

sampler_name.name: Sampler
sampler_name.tooltip: Sampler - Sampling algorithm type, affects generation speed, quality and style

scheduler.name: Scheduler
scheduler.tooltip: Scheduler - Controls the method of gradually removing noise

denoise.name: Denoise Strength
denoise.tooltip: Denoise Strength - Degree of denoising (0.0-1.0), lower values preserve more original content in image editing mode

image1.name: Image 1 (Main)
image1.tooltip: Image 1 (Main) - Primary reference image, used as the editing target in image editing mode

latent.name: Latent (Optional)
latent.tooltip: Latent - External latent input, if provided will use this instead of creating new one

fast_speed_mode.name: Fast Speed Mode
fast_speed_mode.tooltip: Fast Speed Mode - When enabled, same model config won't reload, suitable for continuous generation (only seed/prompt changes)

Memory_cleanup.name: Memory Cleanup
Memory_cleanup.tooltip: Memory Cleanup - Clean up VRAM after generation, suitable for low VRAM scenarios or switching to other nodes

latent.name: Latent
latent.tooltip: Latent - Generated latent space data, can be passed to VAE decoder or other processing nodes

image.name: Image
image.tooltip: Image - Final generated visible image output
